description: Buildings AI is simulationHub's browser-based building performance product, listed on its site alongside autonomous HVAC and valve CFD, with pricing and demo request pages and an announced 'Buildings AI 2027' release that brings AI, simulation and interoperability into one connected workflow. A trade press note (ACHR News, 27 August 2025, secondary) describes it as a cloud-based building energy modelling platform that combines the EnergyPlus engine with AI-driven automation, including AI-assisted model setup, automated compliance checks against energy standards, cloud scaling for large models and several ways to import BIM data, among them a PDF-to-BIM workflow, after testing with design firms in an early access programme. Coverage: generic buildings. Access: commercial subscription through the vendor. Licence: proprietary. Caveats: product claims come from the vendor and trade press, not independent validation; pricing was not read. Simulation uses: rapid energy code compliance and HVAC design studies for architects and engineers. Related records: EnergyPlus and the OpenStudio Server analysis framework.
